mapper.sql: evaluation_id AS evaluationId, evaluation_request_id AS evaluationRequestId, decision_point_id AS decisionPointId, point_version_id AS pointVersionId, release_id AS releaseId, evaluation_mode AS evaluationMode, evaluation_time AS evaluationTime, technical_status AS technicalStatus, proposed_decision AS proposedDecision, business_decision AS businessDecision, decision_adjustment_reason_code AS decisionAdjustmentReasonCode, default_decision_used_flag AS defaultDecisionUsedFlag, started_time AS startedTime, completed_time AS completedTime, elapsed_millis AS elapsedMillis, input_snapshot_hash AS inputSnapshotHash, failure_code AS failureCode, shadow_run_id AS shadowRunId, baseline_evaluation_id AS baselineEvaluationId, decision_changed_flag AS decisionChangedFlag, action_changed_flag AS actionChangedFlag, comparison_severity AS comparisonSeverity, compared_time AS comparedTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_decision_evaluation(evaluation_id, evaluation_request_id, decision_point_id, point_version_id, release_id, evaluation_mode, evaluation_time, technical_status, proposed_decision, business_decision, decision_adjustment_reason_code, default_decision_used_flag, started_time, completed_time, elapsed_millis, input_snapshot_hash, failure_code, shadow_run_id, baseline_evaluation_id, decision_changed_flag, action_changed_flag, comparison_severity, compared_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.evaluationId}, #{row.evaluationRequestId}, #{row.decisionPointId}, #{row.pointVersionId}, #{row.releaseId}, #{row.evaluationMode}, #{row.evaluationTime}, #{row.technicalStatus}, #{row.proposedDecision}, #{row.businessDecision}, #{row.decisionAdjustmentReasonCode}, #{row.defaultDecisionUsedFlag}, #{row.startedTime}, #{row.completedTime}, #{row.elapsedMillis}, #{row.inputSnapshotHash}, #{row.failureCode}, #{row.shadowRunId}, #{row.baselineEvaluationId}, #{row.decisionChangedFlag}, #{row.actionChangedFlag}, #{row.comparisonSeverity}, #{row.comparedTime}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_decision_evaluation WHERE release_id = #{releaseId} AND evaluation_mode = 'PRIMARY' AND technical_status = 'SUCCEEDED' ORDER BY evaluation_time DESC, evaluation_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM t_decision_evaluation WHERE shadow_run_id = #{shadowRunId} ORDER BY evaluation_id
SELECT FROM t_decision_evaluation WHERE baseline_evaluation_id = #{baselineEvaluationId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, evaluation_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
